name: orca-preset-assistant
description: Permission-aware access to Orca presets, live settings, current-project geometry, and print evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Review Orca settings and current-project geometry.
interface.longDescription: Read user presets and print evidence, request live Orca settings or the open project's parts, placement, and model geometry only when the matching permission is enabled, and queue clearly scoped parameter proposals for approval in Orca.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review my Orca settings without reading model geometry.
